blocks.text: Sab se aam physical hazards geele farsh par kaam karte hue phisalna aur girna hain. Kaam karne wale ko phisalne, khinchne (pulling) aur girne jaise accidents se bachne ke liye har tarah ki precaution (ehtiyat) karni chahiye.

Toota hua sheeshe ka saman uthate waqt cut-resistant gloves (kat se bachane wale dastane) pehnein taake kat, abrasion (kharaash) aur skin (jild) ka nuqsan na ho. Lab staff ke liye zaroori ho ke toota sheesha ek khaas container mein dalein taake kisi ko chot na lage.

blocks.prompt: Mez par ek test tube toot jati hai. Ab kya karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Foran lab incharge ko batayein, tukre uthane se pehle cut-resistant gloves pehnein, aur toota sheesha khaas container mein dalein, aam koore ke dabbe mein nahi.
